text_en: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
text_cn: 本雅明的长子贝拉，次子阿市贝耳，三子阿希兰，

text_en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
text_cn: 四子诺哈，五子辣法。

text_en: And Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
text_cn: 贝拉的儿子：阿达尔、厄胡得的父亲革辣、

text_en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
text_cn: 阿彼叔亚、纳阿曼、阿曷亚、

text_en: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
text_cn: 革辣、舍孚番和胡番。

text_en: These are the sons of Ehud (they were heads of ancestral houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they were carried into exile to Manahath):
text_cn: 厄胡得的子孙：──他们是居于革巴的家族的族长，曾被掳往玛纳哈特，──

text_en: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, that is, Heglam, who became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
text_cn: 纳阿曼、阿希雅和革辣。革辣于被掳后，生乌匝和阿希胡得。

text_en: And Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had sent away his wives Hushim and Baara.
text_cn: 沙哈辣殷休了胡生和巴辣两妻后，在摩阿布平原生了儿子；

text_en: He had sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
text_cn: 由自己的妻子曷德士生了约巴布、漆彼雅、默沙、玛耳干、

text_en: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of ancestral houses.
text_cn: 耶乌兹、撒基雅和米尔玛：他们全是家族族长；

text_en: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
text_cn: 由胡生生了阿彼突布和厄耳帕耳。

text_en: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod with its towns,
text_cn: 厄耳帕耳的儿子：厄贝尔、米商和舍默得；舍默得建立了敖诺、罗得和所属村镇。

text_en: and Beriah and Shema (they were heads of ancestral houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath);
text_cn: 贝黎雅和舍玛为住在阿雅隆家族的族长，驱逐了加特的居民。

text_en: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth.
text_cn: 他们的兄弟是厄耳帕耳、沙沙克和耶勒摩特。

text_en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
text_cn: 则巴狄雅、阿辣得、厄德尔、

text_en: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were sons of Beriah.
text_cn: 米加耳、依市帕和约哈，是贝黎雅的儿子。

text_en: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
text_cn: 则贝狄雅、默叔蓝、希次克、赫贝尔、

text_en: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
text_cn: 依市默赖、依次里雅和约巴布，是厄耳帕耳的儿子。

text_en: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
text_cn: 雅肯、齐革黎、匝贝狄、

text_en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
text_cn: 厄里约乃、漆耳泰、厄里耳、

text_en: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
text_cn: 阿达雅、贝辣雅和史默辣特，是史米的儿子。

text_en: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
text_cn: 依市旁、厄贝尔、厄里耳、

text_en: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
text_cn: 阿贝冬、齐革黎、哈南、

text_en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅、厄蓝、安托提雅、

text_en: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
text_cn: 依费德雅、培奴耳：是沙沙克的儿子。

text_en: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
text_cn: 沙默舍赖、舍哈黎雅、阿塔里雅、

text_en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
text_cn: 雅勒舍雅、厄里雅和齐革黎，是耶洛罕的儿子：

text_en: These were the heads of ancestral houses, according to their generations, chiefs. These lived in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 以上是按家系住在耶路撒冷的各家族族长。

text_en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
text_cn: 住在基贝红的，有基贝红的父亲耶依耳，他的妻子名叫玛阿加。

text_en: His firstborn son: Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
text_cn: 他的长子阿贝冬，其次是族尔、克士、巴耳、乃尔、纳达布、

text_en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
text_cn: 革多尔、阿希约、则革尔和

text_en: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. Now these also lived opposite their kindred in Jerusalem, with their kindred.
text_cn: 米刻罗特；米刻罗特生史玛。他们兄弟彼此为邻，住在耶路撒冷。

text_en: Ner became the father of Kish, Kish of Saul, Saul of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal;
text_cn: 乃尔生克士，克士生撒乌耳，撒乌耳生约纳堂、玛耳基叔亚、阿彼纳达布和依市巴耳。

text_en: and the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
text_cn: 约纳堂的儿子：默黎巴耳；默黎巴耳生米加。

text_en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
text_cn: 米加的儿子：丕东、默肋客、塔勒亚和阿哈兹。

text_en: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; Zimri became the father of Moza.
text_cn: 阿哈兹生约阿达，约阿达生阿肋默特、阿次玛委特和齐默黎；齐默黎生摩匝，

text_en: Moza became the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
text_cn: 摩匝生彼纳；彼纳的儿子勒法雅，勒法雅的儿子厄拉撒，厄拉撒的儿子阿责耳；

text_en: Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan; all these were the sons of Azel.
text_cn: 阿责耳有六个儿子，他们的名字是：阿次黎冈、波革鲁、依市玛耳、沙黎雅、敖巴狄雅和哈南：以上是阿责耳的儿子。

text_en: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
text_cn: 他兄弟厄舍克的儿子：长子乌蓝，次子耶乌士，三子厄里培肋特。

text_en: The sons of Ulam were mighty warriors, archers, having many children and grandchildren, one hundred fifty. All these were Benjaminites.
text_cn: 乌蓝的儿子是英勇的战士和射手，有儿孙一百五十八人。以上全是本雅明的子孙。
